measurements.method: 5 warm EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS samples, planner defaults, actual compiled list query

limitations: Synthetic laboratory corpus and warm-cache timings; no production percentiles or cold-disk guarantee.
Queries shorter than three characters have fewer useful trigrams and remain bounded by existing statement timeout.
Cursor order reflects current metadata; concurrent rename/pin/archive can move a chat between pages.

performance_followup.interpretation: Interleaved paired reads did not reproduce an index-presence regression; wide plans did not use the GIN index and remain costly.
